full_track.tags: K-Indie pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, jazz-influenced chord progression with light chorus and reverb. A warm, melodic electric bass follows the guitar's root notes with occasional melodic fills. Drums consist of a soft kick on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp snare on 2 and 4, and steady eighth-note hi-hats. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor with light doubling in the chorus. A subtle electric piano provides sustained harmonic support in the background. Key of E Major, 82 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
